title: One Way or Another
synopsis:
The invincible young man faced the raging wind and waves with a pounding heart and infinite possibilities. Across the continent under the sky, a ray of light pierced the heavens from the swordmaster of Qingshan Mountain! After Grandmaster Jing Yang ascended, the young man Jiu Jing left his mountain home to head for Gushan Mountain. Famed for his handsome looks and lazy attitude, Jiu Jing took a different path for his cultivation, always looking for shortcuts. There were many suspicious signs behind Jing Yang's ascension. What could be hiding in the fog that surround the peaks of Qingshan Mountain?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

episodes.title: The Cat and the Book of Friends
episodes.synopsis: Natsume discovers that the heirloom "Book of Friends" that his grandmother, Reiko, gave him possesses the names of the spirits she defeated and bound to her will. Assisted by a cat whom Natsume addresses as Nyanko-Sensei (lit. Master Little Meow), Natsume aims to return all of the names to their rightful owners.

episodes.title: The Dew-God's Small Shrine
episodes.synopsis: Natsume is visited by the village's local god who is currently fading because of the lack of devotees.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Person At The Eight Fields
episodes.synopsis: Natsume is implored to help spirits who are currently being exorcised. He finds a kindred spirit in Tanuma, a boy who also senses spirits although not as powerful as Natsume.

episodes.title: Shigure and the Girl
episodes.synopsis: Natsume's secret is found out by Sasada, the class president, during the "Trial of Courage." She asks for his help to find the spirit that lives in the abandoned school. Natsume denies the fact that he can see anything, but she won't take no for an answer. Meanwhile, the spirit, Shigure, captures the rest of their school mates, in fury of the school being torn down...

episodes.title: Heart-Colored Ticket
episodes.synopsis: Natsume comes across an old ticket in Reiko's belongings and decides to go to the abandoned train station to see why she kept it. There, he meets a slow witted spirit named Santo, who was waiting for Reiko the entire time to go Kiriganuma, to see and make up with his friend, Mikuri, but the trip isn't as easy as it first seems...

episodes.title: The Swallow at the Water Bottom
episodes.synopsis: Natsume gets possessed by a swallow spirit, who wishes to meet a human that helped her before. Natsume agrees to help her and the two grow attached. When Swallow finds the human, Natsume feels bad that she can't actually meet him, but when of he hears of a kimono that can turn a spirit human for a day, he strives to find it...

episodes.title: The Little Fox's Hat
episodes.synopsis: Natsume goes to a hot spring for a school trip, with an errand from Shigeru to pick up Teacups from a near by pottery. While there he meets and helps a little fox spirit, who quickly grows attached to him.

episodes.title: Fleeting Light
episodes.synopsis: Natsume meets a spirit who used to be friends with a man who could also see spirits, but one day lost this ability.

episodes.title: Ayakashi Exorcism
episodes.synopsis: Natsume meets a popular actor named Natori Shuuichi who can also see spirits, and has a side job as an exorcist.

episodes.title: Asagi's Koto
episodes.synopsis: Natsume is possessed by a sick koto player, whose friend wants her to be able to play one last time.

episodes.title: Nyanko's Book Of Boredom
episodes.synopsis: When Natsume finally has enough of Nyanko's behavior Nyanko leaves, wandering about by himself and causing trouble.

episodes.title: Five Day Mark
episodes.synopsis: Natsume is cursed by an evil spirit which is sealed to a tree, not wanting to trouble his adopted family, he decided to run away from home.

episodes.title: Autumn Banquet
episodes.synopsis: Tanuma finds out Nyanko-Sensei is a spirit. Tanuma and Natsume enjoy the autumn festival and previous acquaintances are seen again.
